body:
`bro` and `bro code` open persistent Goals for long-running parallel workflows. Middle Enter targets the current Goal; Workflow stays read-only. Direct harness shortcuts and transparent `bro acp serve <agent>` remain; retired `bro code <agent>` is rejected. Verified reviewable delivery completes by default, with human acceptance explicitly opt-in.

Planning, reasoning input, review, completion and native/managed ACP workers use ThreadService admission, runner, commit, permission, ownership and shutdown boundaries. GoalStore retains requirements/arrangements/receipts and references ExecutionStore facts. Stable work identity survives worker replacement after old effects are reconciled. Unknown effects and costs remain blocked or held.

The final review follow-up shares typed input/routing decision admission, cancellation and outcome accounting; retains only ModelControl identity/version; reuses checked permission JSON without caching live authorization; replaces ACP private-file polling with an existing protocol observation; and consolidates local PTY/IPC/presentation setup. Normal PTY daemon shutdown now checks its response, wait result and exit 0. Original behavioral coverage, entry combinations, timeouts and retry rules remain.

[Design and diagrams](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a/docs/BRO_ORCHESTRATOR_REFACTOR_IMPLEMENTATION.md), [refactor acceptance](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a/docs/evidence/bro-goal-workflow/2026-10-16-refactor-acceptance.md), [latest review corrections and source binding](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a/docs/evidence/bro-goal-workflow/2026-10-16-review-fixes.md).

Validation on the current executable/test inputs: **4,758 workspace tests passed, 24 skipped, no reported LEAKs or source drift**. Also 33 focused regressions, one five-case ACP restoration matrix plus four real Goal PTY cases, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, fmt, 6 doctests (1 ignored), generated artifacts, SDK default build and ACP-free orchestrator build. The cancellation fixture covers stale requirements, budget, owner transfer retaining unknown costs, and explicit input while paused. Hosted CI is qualified separately at exact commit `d1c9074e9e6654fe77474571d7dc5e078a857c0a`; use the current check results.

[The existing acceptance comment](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/pull/981#issuecomment-6224234670) pins the latest immutable evidence annex with original failures, passing logs, available patches, source hashes, recovery bundle and retained Cargo-built Rust fixture files. Earlier CI-inclusive archive remains pinned at [c0b75b14](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/tree/c0b75b141b3041a1cd9c1284aa16acc27caaab79); pre-refactor evidence remains at [382c2b58](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/tree/382c2b58c5c25b02805175a33d60707dc4227b46). Raw multi-round logs stay outside this feature PR.

Actual vendor harness/provider requalification remains **unpassed**. Controlled Rust ACP peers and SDK fixtures do not attest arbitrary crash takeover, private context, provider billing or production model quality. Future core persistence, complete Turn-fixed routing, dynamic graph editing and Goal owner handoff remain deferred.
